description: One concept, one icon. Each entry answers a 'what is the icon for X?' question with exactly one canonical slug, so the set cannot quietly grow two icons for the same idea. Concepts are UI intents, not drawings — the value may change if a better mark is drawn, but the question keeps its single answer. Where several existing icons compete for a concept, the unnumbered or simplest-named member wins; add a concept here before adding an icon that would answer one already listed.
